verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim PR reviews spot runtime errors, null pointer exceptions, race conditions and logic flaws using multiple AI models, and the CLI claims the same for race conditions and memory leaks. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user says it catches bugs Claude Code misses and another saw it flag a critical security risk in a malicious PR, while one team removed it for being verbose and full of false positives. That complaint tempers confidence but is not a concrete counter-example of missed bugs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of catching broken edge cases, independent measurement of bug-catch rate versus noise and false positives, and a consistent signal-over-style-nits track record in community reports.
